question: Why do polite words for the toilet keep wearing out and needing replacement?
answer: Because each new word catches the old stigma. Water closet gave way to toilet, toilet to bathroom, bathroom to restroom, each at first a delicate way round the thing itself. Once everyone knows what the polite word refers to, it carries the same discomfort. Steven Pinker called this the euphemism treadmill.
move: Renaming a thing changes little until feelings about the thing change.
ask: What am I trying to fix with a new name when the trouble is the thing itself?
reference: Pinker, The Blank Slate: The Modern Denial of Human Nature, Viking, 2002
